title: Model manifest
description: One model's provenance and files, as uploaded to the models bucket. The model-server chart and every benchmark record this manifest.

name.description: Model name used in labels and bucket paths.

sourceRevision.description: Commit hash of the repository revision the files come from.

quantization.description: For example Q4_K_M, or none for full-precision weights.

bucketPath.description: Prefix in the models bucket, models/<name>/<sourceRevision>/.

chatTemplate.description: Where the chat template comes from, or none for models without one.

contextLength.description: Context length in tokens that the deployment allows per request.

path.description: Path within the source repository and under bucketPath.
